summary: Tenon Medical filed an 8-K/A amending a March 2026 report to correct aggregate principal of $5.16M in 20% OID senior convertible notes sold to accredited investors for ~$4.3M gross, with a conversion price at 80% of 3-day VWAP post six-month lockout, maturity September 2026 extendable to December with 5% principal increase, prepayment at 102.5%, and mandatory 15% prepayment from future financing net proceeds. WallachBeth Capital acted as placement agent (7% fee, $65k reimbursement). This is a distressed capital raise with dilutive conversion features; watch for further financing triggers and overhang.
